_comment: Permission allowlist for the resident monitor (loaded via `claude --settings`). In headless `-p` mode, allowlisted Bash prefixes auto-approve and everything else fails closed (no interactive prompt is possible). Containment of remote ssh command CONTENT is by the operator prompt's hard rules + the dedicated revocable SSH key + read-only AWS, NOT by these patterns. Add lambda3-a / lambda3-b ssh entries at multi-node cutover.
